## Grid Bota (all Metric)

```{r}
# Config
basic_config <- list(
  Level = "Family",
  Name = "Fabaceae",
  Type = "bota",
  Year = "2012",
  Radius = 10)

# No filters
grid_filters <- list()

# All metric
all_metrics <- c("Count","NCI","Basal_Area_m2","OTU","Shannon","H1")

# All plots
all_plots <- list()

for (m in all_metrics) {
  grid_config <- basic_config
  grid_config$Metric <- m
  
  # Grid Read
  grid <- grid_read(
    config = grid_config,
    filters = grid_filters
  )
  
  # Plot
  all_plots[[m]] <- plot_grid(grid)
  
}

Wrap <- wrap_plots(all_plots, ncol = 3) + 
  plot_annotation(
    title = paste0("Toutes les Metrics pour l'inventaire :  ", 
                   basic_config$Type, " / ", 
                   basic_config$Level, " / ", 
                   basic_config$Name, " / R = ", 
                   basic_config$Radius
                   )
    )


```

## Geographical correspondance

```{r}

# Morpho
morpho <- import_plants_morpho() %>%
  pull(Species)

# GH
config <- list(
  Type = "genet",
  Rar = FALSE,
  Marker = "GH")

g_gh <- import_genet(config)$motus %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(species)) %>%
  pull(species)

# ITS
config <- list(
  Type = "genet",
  Rar = FALSE,
  Marker = "ITS")

g_its <- import_genet(config)$motus %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(species)) %>%
  pull(species)

# 18S
config <- list(
  Type = "genet",
  Rar = FALSE,
  Marker = "18S")

g_18s <- import_genet(config)$motus %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(species)) %>%
  pull(species)

# Bota
bota <- import_bota(list(Year=2012)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Species)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Species, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  pull(Species)

# Nouragues
nour <- import_plants_nouragues() %>%
  pull(species)

length(morpho)
length(g_gh)
length(g_its)
length(g_18s)
length(bota)
length(nour)

# Diagramme de Venn

library(UpSetR)

# créer une liste
listes <- list(
  M = morpho,
  GH = g_gh,
  ITS = g_its,
  S18 = g_18s,
  B = bota,
  N = nour
)

# convertir en format UpSet
data_upset <- fromList(listes)

# plot

UpSetR::upset(data_upset,
      nsets = ncol(data_upset),
      order.by = "freq",
      show.numbers = "yes",
      set_size.show = TRUE,
      set_size.scale_max = 3000) 



```

# 2. Tables d'Abondance realtives

## Family

### A. Create

```{r}

# ==== TEST 1 ====
test_1 <- expand.grid(
  Type = "genet",
  Rar = c(FALSE,TRUE),
  Marker = c("GH","ITS","18S"),
  Level = c("Family"),
  Metric = "OTU",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Fill results
test_1 <- test_ab_rel_sum(test_1)

# ==== TEST 3 ====
test_3 <- expand.grid(
  Type = "bota",
  Year = "2012",
  Level = "Family",
  Metric = c("OTU","Count","Basal_Area_m2"),
  Radius = "pixel",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Fill results
test_3 <- test_ab_rel_sum(test_3)


# ==== Combine ====
df_ab_rel_Richness <- bind_rows(test_1, test_3)

# View
view(df_ab_rel_Richness)

# Save data
# save( df_combined,
#   file = "~/Bureau/ADNe_Nourague_2026/ADNe_Nourague_2026_files/.ab_rel_count_family.RData")

# load("~/Bureau/ADNe_Nourague_2026/ADNe_Nourague_2026_files/.ab_rel_OTU.RData",
#   envir = .GlobalEnv)

```

### B.1 Table Annexe

```{r}

# Copy
df_reduced <- df_ab_rel_Richness

# Annotate
df_reduced$Result <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(df_reduced)), function(i) {
    df_reduced$Result[[i]] %>% 
    mutate(Metric = round(Metric, digits = 2)) %>%
    mutate( `<2%` = ifelse(Metric < 2 ,TRUE ,FALSE)) %>%
    mutate( `<0.05%` = ifelse(Metric < 0.05 ,TRUE ,FALSE))
  })

# Classify
source_names <- c( "GH","GH", "ITS","ITS", "18S","18S", "Bota")

df_list <- lapply(1:7, function(i) {
  
  # Select
  df <- df_reduced$Result[[i]]
  
  # Ajouter la colonne Source
  df$Source <- source_names[i]
  
  return(df)
})

# Combine
df_plot_rar <-  bind_rows(df_list[c(2,4,6,7)]) %>%
  mutate( in_bota = Clade %in% df_list[7][[1]]$Clade) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!Metric < 0.5)

# Plot
ab_rel_tab(df_plot_rar)

```


### B.2 Replace \< 2% families

```{r}

df_reduced <- df_ab_rel_Richness

df_reduced$Result <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(df_reduced)), function(i) {
    df_reduced$Result[[i]] %>% percent_other("Clade", "Metric", 2)
  })


# Liste des indices correspondant aux différentes sources
source_indices <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7)
source_names <- c( "GH","GH", "ITS","ITS", "18S","18S", "Bota")

# Appliquer une fonction à chaque élément de la liste df_reduced$Result
df_list <- lapply(seq_along(source_indices), function(i) {
  # Extraire le dataframe correspondant
  df_temp <- df_reduced$Result[[source_indices[i]]]
  
  # Ajouter la colonne Source
  df_temp$Source <- source_names[i]
  
  return(df_temp)
})

```

### C. Plots Ab_rel et Growth_form

```{r}

# All families
all_fam <-  bind_rows(df_list[c(2,4,6,7)]) %>% 
  # dplyr::filter(Clade != "<2%") %>%
  # dplyr::filter(Clade != "Indet.") %>%
  pull(Clade) %>%
  unique()

# Bota families
bota_fam <- df_list[7][[1]]$Clade

# Genet families
gen_fam <- bind_rows(df_list[c(2,4,6)]) %>% 
  # dplyr::filter(Clade != "<2%") %>%
  # dplyr::filter(Clade != "Indet.") %>%
  pull(Clade) %>%
  unique()

# Bota test color
all_fam_df <- data.frame(
  family = all_fam,
  Clade = all_fam,
  in_bota = all_fam %in% bota_fam & !all_fam %in% gen_fam,
  in_genet = all_fam %in% gen_fam & !all_fam %in% bota_fam,
  in_both = all_fam %in% bota_fam & all_fam %in% gen_fam
)

# Sélectionner les éléments de df_list à combiner
df_plot_rar <- bind_rows(df_list[c(2, 4, 6, 7)]) %>%
  left_join(all_fam_df, by = "Clade")

# Plot abondance relative
p1 <- ab_rel_plot(df_plot_rar)

# Growth form
growth_form <- growth_form_family(all_fam_df)
p2 <- growth_form_plot(growth_form)

# Patchwork
(p1 | p2)
```

### D. Linear model BA / OTU

```{r}


# List of dataframes
dfs <- list(
  OTU    = df_ab_rel_Richness$Result[[7]],
  BA  = df_ab_rel_Richness$Result[[9]]
)

# Combine dataframes
compare <- dfs %>%
  imap(~ rename(.x, !!.y := Metric)) %>%   # renomme Metric avec le nom de la liste
  reduce(inner_join, by = "Clade")     # inner join

# Plot
ggplot(compare, aes(x = OTU, y = BA)) +
  geom_point() +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_light() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", col = "red") +
  labs(
    y = "Basal Area (m²)",
    x = "OTU Richness"
  )
```

```{r}

# List of dataframes
dfs <- list(
  genet    = df_ab_rel_Richness$Result[[2]],
  bota  = df_ab_rel_Richness$Result[[9]]
)

# Combine dataframes
compare <- dfs %>%
  imap(~ rename(.x, !!.y := Metric)) %>%   # renomme Metric avec le nom de la liste
  reduce(inner_join, by = "Clade")     # inner join

# Plot
ggplot(compare, aes(x = genet, y = bota)) +
  geom_point() +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_light() +
```

## C. Tests Statistiques

### Test : Correlation \~ Metric_corr

```{r}
# ANOVA Test : Count / NCI
res_aov <- aov(Correlation ~ Metric_corr, data = tab_rar[tab_rar$Metric_corr %in% c("Count","NCI","MCC"),])
summary(res_aov)

#              Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)  
# Metric_corr   2   0.14 0.07012    2.35 0.0963 .
# Residuals   555  16.56 0.02983                 
# ---
# Signif. codes:  0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1
# 729 observations effacées parce que manquantes

# Moyenne ajustée
library(emmeans)
emm <- emmeans(res_aov, pairwise ~ Metric_corr)
plot(emm)

# Letters
library(multcompView)
tuk <- TukeyHSD(res_aov)
multcompLetters4(res_aov, tuk)

# a a a

```

### Test : Correlation \~ Level

```{r}
# ANOVA Test : Species / Genus / Family
res_aov <- aov(Correlation ~ Level, data = tab_rar[tab_rar$Metric_corr %in% c("Count","NCI","MCC"),])
summary(res_aov)

#              Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)  
# Level         2  0.143 0.07154   2.399 0.0918 .
# Residuals   555 16.554 0.02983                 
# ---
# Signif. codes:  0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1
# 729 observations effacées parce que manquantes

# Moyenne ajustée
library(emmeans)
emm <- emmeans(res_aov, pairwise ~ Level)
plot(emm)

# Letters
library(multcompView)
tuk <- TukeyHSD(res_aov)
multcompLetters4(res_aov, tuk)

# a a a

```

# 4. Abiotic Factors

## Abiotic Pannel

```{r}

# Import
abiotic <- import_abiotic() %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(x,y))

# Abiotic variables
abiotic_vars <- colnames(abiotic) 

# Plot list
plot_list <- list()

# Plot loop
for(i in 1:length(abiotic_vars)){
  
  # Metric
  metric <- abiotic_vars[[i]]
  print(metric)
  
  # Config
  config <- list(
    Type = "abiotic",
    Metric = metric)
  
  # Grid
  grid <- grid_read(config)
  
  # Plot
  plot_list[[i]] <- plot_grid(grid) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(caption = grid$config$Name) +
    theme(
      plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,   # centré
        size = 9,
        face = "bold.italic"
      )
    )
  
}

wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 10)

```


## Reads VS Light

```{r}

# Abiotic
config <- list(
  Type = "abiotic",
  Metric = "light")
  
# Grid
light <- grid_read(config)

# Genet
config <- list(
  Type = "genet",
  Rar = FALSE,
  Marker = "GH",
  Level = "Family",
  Name = "All",
  Metric = "Reads")

# Grid
reads <- grid_read(config)

# Bota
config <- list(
  Level = "Family",
  Name = "All",
  Type = "bota",
  Year = "2012",
  Radius = "pixel",
  Metric = "Basal_Area_m2"
  )

BA <- grid_read(config)

# List of dataframes
dfs <- list(
  light = light$df,
  reads = reads$df,
  BA    = BA$df
)

# Combine dataframes
compare <- dfs %>%
  imap(~ rename(.x, !!.y := Metric)) %>%   # renomme Metric avec le nom de la liste
  reduce(inner_join, by = c("x", "y"))     # inner join

# Plot
ggplot(compare, aes(x = light, y = reads, colour = log(BA+1))) +
  geom_point()

```


```{r}
ggplot(compare, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = log(reads+1))) +
  geom_tile() +
  coord_fixed() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c()
```


```{r}
library(gstat)
library(sp)

coordinates(compare) <- ~ x + y
v <- variogram(reads ~ 1, compare)
plot(v)
```

```{r}
library(spdep)

coords <- as.matrix(compare[, c("x", "y")])
nb <- spdep::dnearneigh(coords, 0, 1)  # voisins à distance ≤ 1 unité
lw <- spdep::nb2listw(nb, style = "W")
spdep::moran.test(compare$reads, lw)
```

## Random Forest

```{r}
library(randomForest)

set.seed(123)

abiotic <- import_abiotic()
genet <- reads$df %>% rename(reads = Metric)
data_pixel <- inner_join(genet, abiotic, by = c("x","y"))

rf_model <- randomForest(
  reads ~ .,              # toutes les variables explicatives
  data = data_pixel %>% dplyr::select(-x, -y),  # enlever coordonnées si non pertinentes
  ntree = 500,
  importance = TRUE
)

# importance des variables
importance(rf_model)
varImpPlot(rf_model)

# Plot
library(ggplot2)

var_imp <- as.data.frame(importance(rf_model))
var_imp$Variable <- rownames(var_imp)

ggplot(var_imp, aes(x = reorder(Variable, `%IncMSE`), y = `%IncMSE`)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(y = "%IncMSE", x = "", title = "Importance des variables pour log(reads)")

# Impacte d'une variable :
library(pdp)
partial(rf_model, pred.var = "Cd") %>% plotPartial()

```


### Cross validation par block spatiaux

```{r}

# Creation des blocks spatiaux
library(sf)

# Transformer data_pixel en sf
data_pixel_sf <- st_as_sf(
  data_pixel,
  coords = c("x", "y"),  # colonnes pour les coordonnées
  crs = 4326             # CRS arbitraire, à adapter si nécessaire
)

# Transformer en CRS projecté arbitraire (unités locales)
data_pixel_sf <- st_set_crs(data_pixel_sf, NA) %>%  # retirer CRS actuel
  st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"))                     # reconvertir en sf POINT

# s'assurer que log_reads existe
data_pixel_sf$log_reads <- log1p(data_pixel_sf$reads)

library(blockCV)

# séparer x et y
x_sf <- data_pixel_sf %>% dplyr::select(-reads, -log_reads)  # sf avec toutes les variables explicatives + geometry
y_var <- data_pixel_sf$log_reads                      # réponse

# lancer la CV spatiale
spatial_cv <- cv_spatial(
  x = x_sf,          # sf avec géométrie
  y = y_var,         # vecteur réponse
  k = 5,             # nombre de folds
  selection = "random",
  theRange = 5 ,      # taille du bloc spatial
  plot = FALSE
)

library(ggplot2)

# extraire x et y depuis geometry
data_pixel_sf <- data_pixel_sf %>%
  mutate(
    x = st_coordinates(.)[,1],  # première colonne = x
    y = st_coordinates(.)[,2]   # deuxième colonne = y
  )

data_pixel_sf$foldID <- spatial_cv$folds_ids

# Verification des blocks spatiaux
ggplot(data_pixel_sf) +
  geom_point(aes(x = x, y = y, color = as.factor(foldID))) +
  coord_fixed() +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  labs(title = "Blocs CV spatiaux", color = "Fold")

# Créer la liste de folds pour caret
folds_list <- lapply(unique(data_pixel_sf$foldID), function(f) {
  which(data_pixel_sf$foldID != f)  # toutes les lignes sauf celles du fold f (train)
})

# Cross validation

library(caret)
library(randomForest)

# transformer sf en data.frame classique (enlever geometry)
data_df <- data_pixel_sf %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::select(-foldID, -reads)  # foldID est seulement pour CV, pas pour le modèle

# ajouter la variable réponse
data_df$log_reads <- log1p(data_pixel_sf$reads)

# Définir le contrôle de CV pour caret
train_control <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  index = folds_list
)

# Entraîner le modèle Random Forest
rf_cv <- train(
  log_reads ~ .,          # toutes les variables explicatives
  data = data_df,
  method = "rf",
  trControl = train_control,
  ntree = 500
)


# Évaluation des performances
print(rf_cv)
rf_cv$results
rf_cv$finalModel


```

# III. DIVERSITY PATTERNS

## 1. Rank / Abundance Curve

```{r}

library("entropart")

# BOTA
rank_ab_vec_bota <- function(df, Level){
  df %>% 
    group_by(.data[[Level]]) %>% 
    summarize(Abundance = n()) %>%
    arrange(desc(Abundance)) %>%
    mutate(Rank = 1:length(Abundance))
}

plot_Whittaker_bota <- function(df, Level){
  Ab_tib <- rank_ab_vec_bota(df, Level)

  # Build a named vector
  Ab_vec <- Ab_tib$Abundance
  names(Ab_vec) <- Ab_tib[[Level]]
  
  # Vector of abundances
  Ab_vec %>% as.AbdVector() -> Ab_vec
  
  # Whittaker plot
  plot(Ab_vec, Distribution = "lnorm", main = "Bota")
  param <- RAClnorm(Ab_vec)
  text(0.8*max(Ab_tib$Rank),0.5*max(Ab_tib$Abundance),paste0("mu = ", round(param$mu,digits = 3), "\n sigma = ", round(param$sigma,digits = 3)))
}

# WHITTAKER PLOT
bota <- import_bota(list("Year" = 2012))
plot_Whittaker_bota(bota, "Species")


# GENET

# Rank Tibble
rank_ab_vec_genet <- function(df, Level){
  
  Reads <- colSums(df$reads)
  as.data.frame(Reads) -> Reads
  Reads$id <- row.names(Reads)
  
  Ab_tib <- left_join(df$motus, Reads, by = "id") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[Level]])) %>%
    group_by(.data[[Level]]) %>%
    summarise(Reads = sum(Reads))
  
  Ab_tib %>% 
    arrange(desc(Reads)) %>%
    mutate(Rank = 1:length(Reads))
}

# Whittaker plot
plot_Whittaker_genet <- function(df, Level){
  
  Ab_tib <- rank_ab_vec_genet(df, Level)

  # Build a named vector
  Ab_vec <- Ab_tib$Reads
  names(Ab_vec) <- Ab_tib[[Level]]
  
  # Vector of abundances
  Ab_vec %>% as.AbdVector() -> Ab_vec
  
  # Whittaker plot
  plot(Ab_vec, Distribution = "lnorm", ylab = "Reads")
  param <- RAClnorm(Ab_vec)
  text(0.8*max(Ab_tib$Rank),0.5*max(Ab_tib$Reads),paste0("mu = ", round(param$mu,digits = 3), "\n sigma = ", round(param$sigma,digits = 3)))
}

# Plot list
par(mfrow = c(1,3))

bota <- import_bota(list("Year" = 2012))
plot_Whittaker_bota(bota, "Family")

plot_list <- lapply(c("GH","ITS"), function(m){
  metabarlist <- import_genet(
  list(
    "Marker" = m,
    "Rar" = TRUE
  ))
  plot_Whittaker_genet(metabarlist, "family")
  title(main = m)
})
```

```{r}
plot_log_log <- function(Ab1, Ab2, marker){
  Ab_join_GH <- inner_join(Ab1, Ab2, by = "Family")
  
  ggplot(Ab_join_GH,aes(x = log(Abundance),y = log(Reads))) +
    theme_light() +
    geom_point() +

    labs(title = paste0(marker, " ~ Bota")) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16))
}

p2 <- plot_log_log(Ab_bota, Ab_ITS, "ITS")
```

## 3. Diversity distance-decay (Irène)
```{r}

divLeinster <- function(q=2 ,spxp , Z=NULL,  check = TRUE){
  #Calcul the diversity of each site of sites by species matrix. 
  #spxp columns and Z rows and columns are assumed to be in the same order.

  if (is.null(Z)) Z <- diag(ncol(spxp))
  if (check){
    if (!inherits(spxp, "matrix")) {
      stop("object \"spxp\" is not of class \"matrix\"")}  
    if (!inherits(Z, "matrix")) {
      stop("object \"Z\" is not of class \"matrix\"")}  
    if (!all(c(ncol(Z), nrow(Z)) == ncol(spxp))){
      stop("object \"Z\" and object \"spxp\" does not have matching dimensions")}
  }  

  spxp <- sweep(spxp, 1, rowSums(spxp), "/")
  Zp <- Z %*% t(spxp)

  if (q != 1 & q != Inf){
    mat <- t(spxp) * (Zp)^(q-1)
    mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0
    D <- colSums(mat) ^ (1/(1-q))
  }

  if (q==Inf)  {
    D <- 1/ apply(Zp, 2, max)
  }  

  if (q == 1){
    D <- apply(Zp^t(spxp), 2, function(x) 1/prod(x))
  }

  return(D)
}


abgDecompQ <- function(spxp, Z=NULL, q=2, check=TRUE) {
  #Calcul the diversity of each site of sites by species matrix. 
  #spxp columns and Z rows/cols are assumed to be in the same order.

  if (is.null(Z)) Z <- diag(ncol(spxp))
  if (check){
    if (!inherits(spxp, "matrix")) {
      stop("object \"spxp\" is not of class \"matrix\"")}  
    if (!inherits(Z, "matrix")) {
      stop("object \"Z\" is not of class \"matrix\"")}  
    if (!all(c(ncol(Z), nrow(Z)) == ncol(spxp))){
      stop("object \"Z\" and object \"spxp\" does not have matching dimensions")}
  }

  site.weight <- rep(1/nrow(spxp), nrow(spxp))
  spxp <- sweep(spxp, 1, rowSums(spxp), "/")

  gamma.ab <- colSums(sweep(spxp, 1, site.weight, "*"))

  Gamma <- divLeinster(t(as.matrix(gamma.ab)), Z=Z , q=q, check = FALSE)
  Alphas <- divLeinster(spxp, Z=Z , q=q, check = FALSE) 

  if (q != 1 & q != Inf) {
    mAlpha <- (sum(site.weight * (Alphas ^ (1 - q))))^(1 / (1 - q))
  }

  if (q==1){
    mAlpha <- exp(sum(site.weight * log(Alphas)))
  }

  if (q==Inf){
    mAlpha <- min(Alphas)
  }

  Beta <- Gamma / mAlpha

  names(Alphas) <- row.names(spxp)
  res <- list(Gamma=Gamma, Beta=Beta, mAlpha=mAlpha, Alphas=Alphas)

  return(res)
}

BetaDisQ <- function(q=2,spxp, Z=NULL, check = TRUE){
  #Calcul the site pairwise diversity of a sites by species matrix. 
  #spxp columns and Z rows/cols are assumed to be in the same order.
  # this function uses the Jaccard‐type overlap (UqN) as a measure of similarity

  N <- nrow(spxp)
  dis <- matrix(NA, N, N)
  
  for (i in 2:N) {
    for (j in 1:(i-1)) {
      spxp.dummy <- spxp[c(i,j), ]
      res <- abgDecompQ(as.matrix(spxp.dummy), Z = NULL, q = q, check = FALSE)
      dis[i, j] <- dis[j, i] <- res$Beta
    }
  }

  diag(dis) <- 1
  dis <- dis - 1
  row.names(dis) <- colnames(dis) <- row.names(spxp)

  return(dis)
}


# Execution :

# Import data
GH <- import_genet(list("Rar" = TRUE, "Marker" = "GH"))
ta_matrice_OTU <- GH$reads

# Group by family
fam_vec <- GH$motus %>% 
  drop_na(family) %>% 
  pull(family) %>% 
  unique()

n_fam <- length(fam_vec)
N <- nrow(ta_matrice_OTU)
ta_matrice_family <- matrix(NA, N, n_fam)
row.names(ta_matrice_family) <- row.names(ta_matrice_OTU)
colnames(ta_matrice_family) <- fam_vec

for (i in 1:n_fam) {
  fam <- fam_vec[i]
  grid <- grid_read(list("Type"="genet","Rar"=TRUE, "Marker"="GH", "Level"="Family", "Name"=fam, "Metric"="Reads"))
  ta_matrice_family[,i] <- grid$df$Metric
}

view(ta_matrice_family)

# Matrice de similarité
beta.sim <- BetaDisQ(spxp = ta_matrice_family, q=1)
beta.sim ## we obtain a similarity matrix

# Matrice de distance

xy_loc <- grid_read(list("Type"="genet","Rar"=TRUE, "Marker"="GH", "Level"="Family", "Name"=fam_vec[1], "Metric"="Reads"))$df %>% dplyr::select(-Metric)

dist_mat <- as.matrix(dist(xy_loc[, c("x", "y")]))
row.names(dist_mat) <- colnames(dist_mat) <- row.names(spxp)
  

# Distance-decay Plot

sim_df  <- as.data.frame(as.table(beta.sim))
dist_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(dist_mat))

colnames(sim_df)  <- c("point1", "point2", "similarity")
colnames(dist_df) <- c("point1", "point2", "distance")

df <- merge(dist_df, sim_df, by = c("point1", "point2"))

df <- df[df$point1 != df$point2, ]

df <- df[as.character(df$point1) < as.character(df$point2), ]

df_pt1 <- df[df$point1 == "017", ]

ggplot(df_pt1, aes(x = distance, y = similarity)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal()





```

## 5. Random Forest

```{r}
library(randomForest)

# Random forest function
rand_for_IncMSE <- function(data_pixel){
  
  set.seed(123) # For reproductibility
  
  rf_model <- randomForest(
    Metric ~ .,              # toutes les variables explicatives
    data = data_pixel %>% dplyr::select(-x, -y, -sample_loc),  # enlever coordonnées si non pertinentes
    ntree = 500,
    importance = TRUE
  )
  
  # # importance des variables
  # importance(rf_model)
  # varImpPlot(rf_model)
  
  # Plot
  var_imp <- as.data.frame(importance(rf_model))
  var_imp$Variable <- rownames(var_imp)
  
  ggplot(var_imp, aes(x = reorder(Variable, `%IncMSE`), y = `%IncMSE`)) +
    geom_col(fill = "grey") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_light() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,size = 12, face="bold"),
      axis.text.y.left = element_text(face="bold")
    )
}

# Import data
abiotic <- import_abiotic() %>%
  dplyr::select(x,y,light,canop12,topo,wetness,C,Ca,Al,K)

genet <- GH_H1_grid$df
bota <- bota_H1_grid$df



# Bota Plot
data_pixel_bota <- inner_join(bota, abiotic, by = c("x","y"))
p3 <- rand_for_IncMSE(data_pixel_bota) +
  labs(y = "%IncMSE", x = "", title = "Bota")

# Genet Plot
data_pixel_genet <- inner_join(genet, abiotic, by = c("x","y"))
p4 <- rand_for_IncMSE(data_pixel_genet) +
  labs(y = "%IncMSE", x = "", title = "GH")

# Multiplot
(p1 | p2) /
(p3 | p4)
```
